name: Plinth US Grants Data
description: The US grantmaking universe as an API — about 205,000 grantmaking foundations and 17.9 million grants, read from public IRS Form 990, 990-EZ and 990-PF e-file filings. A JSON REST API with an OpenAPI 3.1 description, an ad-hoc SQL endpoint, and an MCP server for agents. Free key, no card; every figure traceable to a named filing.

apis.name: Plinth Grants API
apis.description: Read the whole US funding graph in both directions: everything a foundation funded (funder_id) or every funder behind a nonprofit (recip_id), plus organization profiles, an IRS compliance and OFAC screen, federal and state government funding, and ad-hoc read-only SQL. Parameter and field names follow the vocabulary of existing grant data APIs, so an existing client is close to drop-in. Start at /api/search, which resolves a name to an EIN and needs no key.
